newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: UNI-INVEST TOTAL INV. RESULT UP 67.8 PCT.
newsitem.headline: UNI-INVEST TOTAL INV. RESULT UP 67.8 PCT.

text.p: Dutch property investment fund Uni-Invest said on Tuesday its total investment result increased by 67.8 percent to 63.1 million guilders.

Compared to 1995, direct investment result per share grew over twenty percent to 2.26 guilders per share, resulting in a total investment result of 2.92 guilders per share compared to 2.60 in 1995, Uni-Invest said.
Uni-Invest said it would pay a final 1996 dividend of 1.60 guilders per share, taking the total pay-out for the year to 2.05 guilders, up some 14 percent from 1995.
The fund said it would propose an interim dividend of 0.55 guilders per share over the first quarter of 1997 at the next general shareholders' meeting on April 22.
Uni-Invest said it would acquire real estate worth some 330 million guilders in February and March of this year.
The fund said it expected the total investment result per share to increase by over five percent.
Direct investment result per share is equivalent to net profit.
Total investment results include changes in the value of the fund's portfolio.
